release_notes: Specs per official Bosch datasheet (AUTODOME_IP_5000_HD_Data_sheet_enUS_19166825227.pdf, V12 Jan 2017). NEZ-5230-PPCW4 = 30x 1080p30 camera in indoor housing for pendant installation, clear bubble (P = indoor pendant; E = outdoor pendant with sunshield; C = in-ceiling). The datasheet lists IP66 / IK10 and -40 to 60 C (24 VAC; -20 to 60 C on PoE+) for "pendant models" without separating the indoor pendant from the outdoor pendant, so IP/IK ratings are not recorded for this indoor housing; the temperature range shown is that pendant-models value. The 1080p outdoor pendant NEZ-5230-EPCW4 is in autodome-ip-5000-hd.json. Sensitivity: colour 0.22 lux / mono 0.044 lux at 30 IRE, SensUp off. Power consumption 24 VAC: 14 W (24 W with heater); PoE+: 13 W (heater not supported). Status discontinued follows the existing family record (autodome-ip-5000-hd.json); the datasheet itself does not state it.
